Initial release of greenhelix-bundle-agent-commerce-foundations

- Launches a comprehensive bundle for agent-to-agent commerce, focused on B2B transactions and autonomous systems.
- Includes 6 expert guides covering API migration, security hardening, payments, pricing strategy, and multi-agent orchestration.
- Offers bundled pricing at $149 (total individual value: $184).
- Compatible with openclaw and licensed under MIT.
